column2: A mirror slides.|It stops by Gail.
column3: A little mirror slides to Gail.|She looks at her face in it.
column4: A little mirror slides across Gail’s bedroom floor and stops beside her.|She leans closer to see her reflection in the glass.
column5: 一面鏡子滑過來。|它停在瑜瑜身旁。
column6: 小鏡子滑向瑜瑜。|她看著鏡中的臉。
column7: 小鏡子滑過瑜瑜房間的地板，停在她身旁。|她靠近一點，看著玻璃裡自己的倒影。

column2: Now it glows.|A fair is near!
column3: The mirror stops and glows.|A bright fair opens before Gail.
column4: After the mirror has stopped, a thread of light curls out of its frame.|The light opens a doorway to a castle fair filled with games.
column5: 現在它發光了。|市集就在眼前！
column6: 鏡子停下來，發出光芒。|明亮的市集出現在瑜瑜面前。
column7: 鏡子停穩後，一縷光從鏡框繞出來。|光芒打開入口，通往有各種遊戲的城堡市集。

column2: So many games!|Gail looks around.
column3: Gail sees games at the fair.|Her friends like different things.
column4: At the fair, there are places to run, dance, paint, and work on a puzzle.|Gail’s friends are excited about different activities, and she wants to try them too.
column5: 好多遊戲！|瑜瑜四處看看。
column6: 瑜瑜看見市集裡的遊戲。|朋友們喜歡不同的事物。
column7: 市集裡有可以跑步、跳舞、畫畫和拼圖的地方。|朋友們對不同活動感到興奮，她也想試試。

column2: Rabbit runs fast.|Gail claps.
column3: Rabbit runs and wins a medal.|Gail claps for her friend.
column4: Rabbit runs down the path with quick, light steps and wins a medal.|Gail claps because she can admire her friend’s speed without running as fast herself.
column5: 兔兔跑得快。|瑜瑜拍手。
column6: 兔兔跑步，贏了一面獎牌。|瑜瑜為朋友拍手。
column7: 兔兔沿著小路輕快地跑，贏得一面獎牌。|瑜瑜拍手，因為即使自己沒跑那麼快，也能欣賞朋友的速度。

column2: Swan can dance.|She turns and turns.
column3: Swan does a lovely dance.|She moves at her own pace.
column4: Swan makes a graceful turn and moves to the music at her own pace.|Gail watches the dance and notices a talent that is different from Rabbit’s.
column5: 天鵝會跳舞。|她轉呀轉。
column6: 天鵝跳著優美的舞。|她按照自己的步調移動。
column7: 天鵝優雅地轉身，跟著音樂按自己的步調移動。|瑜瑜看著舞蹈，發現那是和兔兔不同的才能。

column2: Owl looks closely.|The pieces fit!
column3: Owl looks at a puzzle.|He finds where the pieces go.
column4: At the puzzle table, Owl studies the corners and the shapes of each piece.|Gail is impressed by how patiently he finds a place for them.
column5: 貓頭鷹仔細看。|拼片合起來了！
column6: 貓頭鷹看著拼圖。|他找出拼片該放哪裡。
column7: 在拼圖桌前，貓頭鷹研究每一片的角落和形狀。|瑜瑜佩服他耐心找出拼片位置的本領。

column2: Gail tries too.|She is not first.
column3: Gail tries the games too.|She does not win a medal.
column4: Gail tries the games, but she is not the fastest runner or the most practiced dancer.|When she starts to compare every result, the fun begins to fade.
column5: 瑜瑜也試試。|她不是第一名。
column6: 瑜瑜也試了遊戲。|她沒有贏得獎牌。
column7: 瑜瑜嘗試遊戲，但她不是最快的跑者，也不是最熟練的舞者。|當她開始比較每個結果，樂趣逐漸消失。

column2: The medals look big.|Gail looks small.
column3: The mirror makes medals look big.|Gail looks very small in it.
column4: The magic mirror makes the medals look enormous and Gail’s reflection look tiny.|Its strange portrait makes her feel as if prizes are the only things that matter.
column5: 獎牌看起來好大。|瑜瑜看起來好小。
column6: 鏡子讓獎牌看起來很大。|鏡中的瑜瑜非常小。
column7: 魔法鏡把獎牌變得巨大，把瑜瑜的倒影變得很小。|這幅奇怪的肖像讓她覺得，好像只有獎品才重要。

column2: “Am I good?”|Gail feels small.
column3: Gail looks at the mirror again.|She forgets what she has learned.
column4: Gail keeps checking whether she is better than someone else.|She stops noticing her own small improvements because the mirror always points to a winner.
column5: 「我好嗎？」|瑜瑜覺得自己很渺小。
column6: 瑜瑜又看了一次鏡子。|她忘了自己已經學到的事。
column7: 瑜瑜不斷確認自己有沒有比別人厲害。|鏡子總是指向贏家，讓她不再留意自己的小進步。

column2: Oh! The pieces fly!|Where do they go?
column3: Wind scatters the star puzzle.|The friends stop their games.
column4: A sudden wind scatters the pieces of a star puzzle across the table.|The friends leave their games and gather to help put it back together.
column5: 哎呀！拼片飛了！|它們跑去哪裡？
column6: 風把星星拼圖吹散了。|朋友們停下遊戲。
column7: 一陣突如其來的風把星星拼圖吹散在桌上。|朋友們離開遊戲，一起幫忙把拼圖拼回去。

column2: They all try.|It is a jumble!
column3: The friends all try to help.|But they work in different ways.
column4: Rabbit fetches pieces while Swan and Owl reach for some of the same ones.|Their ideas are different, and nobody is sure which job to do first.
column5: 大家都試試。|全亂成一團了！
column6: 朋友們都想幫忙。|但大家用的方法不一樣。
column7: 兔兔拿來拼片，天鵝和貓頭鷹卻伸手拿同樣的幾片。|大家想法不同，也不確定該先做哪一件事。

column2: Gail listens.|“Let’s share the jobs.”
column3: Gail listens to each friend.|They choose jobs they can do well.
column4: Gail listens to each friend and suggests sharing the jobs.|Each friend has a useful strength, even though none of them can do every part alone.
column5: 瑜瑜仔細聽。|「我們分工吧。」
column6: 瑜瑜聽每位朋友說。|大家選擅長的工作。
column7: 瑜瑜聽完每位朋友的想法，提議分工。|每位朋友都有派得上用場的優點，雖然沒有人能獨自完成全部。

column2: Rabbit brings pieces.|Here they are!
column3: Rabbit brings the far pieces back.|His quick feet help the group.
column4: Rabbit gathers the pieces that have slid far away.|The same quick feet Gail admired during the race now help the whole group.
column5: 兔兔帶來拼片。|都在這裡！
column6: 兔兔把遠處的拼片帶回來。|他的快腳幫上了大家。
column7: 兔兔收集滑到遠處的拼片。|瑜瑜在比賽時欣賞的快腳，現在幫助了整個團隊。

column2: These look similar.|Swan puts them near.
column3: Swan finds pieces with similar curves.|She sets them side by side.
column4: Swan notices similar curves on several pieces and places them together.|Her eye for shape helps the friends see how the edges might fit.
column5: 這些看起來相似。|天鵝把它們放近。
column6: 天鵝找到曲線相似的拼片。|她把它們並排放好。
column7: 天鵝發現幾片拼圖有相似的曲線，就把它們放在一起。|她觀察形狀的能力，幫大家看出邊緣可能如何接合。

column2: One corner is missing.|Owl finds it!
column3: Owl checks the last corner.|He finds the missing piece.
column4: Owl looks closely at the unfinished corner and finds a missing piece.|His patient checking is another talent the group needs.
column5: 少了一個角。|貓頭鷹找到了！
column6: 貓頭鷹檢查最後一個角。|他找到缺少的拼片。
column7: 貓頭鷹仔細看還沒完成的角落，找到一片缺少的拼圖。|他耐心檢查的本領，也是團隊需要的才能。

column2: This one comes next.|Gail shows the way.
column3: Gail puts the pieces in order.|The star begins to take shape.
column4: Gail uses the pieces her friends have gathered to plan the next steps.|She begins to value her own ability to keep track of how the parts fit together.
column5: 接著是這一片。|瑜瑜示範怎麼做。
column6: 瑜瑜依序排好拼片。|星星開始成形了。
column7: 瑜瑜運用朋友收集的拼片，規劃接下來的步驟。|她開始珍惜自己能理清各部分如何組合的能力。

column2: The star is whole!|They all helped.
column3: The friends finish the star.|Each friend helped in a unique way.
column4: The last piece fits, and a bright star appears on the table.|Each friend has made a unique contribution; the puzzle needed all of them.
column5: 星星完整了！|大家都有幫忙。
column6: 朋友們完成了星星。|每位朋友都用獨特的方式幫忙。
column7: 最後一片拼上去，桌上出現一顆明亮的星星。|每位朋友都作出了獨特的貢獻，拼圖需要他們每一位。

column2: Look in the mirror.|They all matter.
column3: The mirror shows all the friends.|No one looks smaller now.
column4: This time, the mirror shows the friends at an equal size beside their shared work.|Their skills are different, but each person matters just as much.
column5: 看看鏡子。|每個人都重要。
column6: 鏡子映出所有朋友。|現在沒有人比較小。
column7: 這一次，鏡子把朋友們映得一樣大，站在共同的作品旁。|大家的本領不同，但每個人都同樣重要。

column2: “I learned something.”|Gail smiles at herself.
column3: Gail thinks about her own work.|She can see how she improved.
column4: Gail looks at herself and remembers what she could do before today.|She can improve without being better than every friend at every activity.
column5: 「我學到了東西。」|瑜瑜對自己笑了。
column6: 瑜瑜想著自己的努力。|她看得出自己進步了。
column7: 瑜瑜看著自己，回想今天之前她會做的事。|她可以持續進步，不必每項活動都比每個朋友厲害。

column2: Back at home.|“I can be me.”
column3: Gail is home with her mirror.|It shows her just as she is.
column4: Back in her bedroom, Gail sees an ordinary reflection in the quiet mirror.|She is glad to be herself, with her own pace and more things to learn.
column5: 回到家了。|「我可以做自己。」
column6: 瑜瑜帶著鏡子回家了。|鏡子映出她原本的樣子。
column7: 回到房間，瑜瑜在安靜的鏡子裡看見平常的倒影。|她很高興能做自己，用自己的步調繼續學習。
